interface.longDescription: Speed up or slow down a short video with matching audio tempo. Choose 0.5, 0.75, 1.25, 1.5 or 2 times playback speed. Preview and download the completed MP4 inline. A connected Firemoon account is required.
defaultPrompt: Make my attached video play at 1.5 times speed.

publication.release_notes: Adds a branded welcome page with editable starter ideas, OpenAI SDK controls, responsive uploads and OAuth configuration. Keeps inline playback, fullscreen, downloads and saved-preview recovery.
